title: The Cities of Refuge Are Selected
description: The Lord commanded Joshua to select the cities of refuge that Moses had spoken about, so that anyone who kills a person by accident can flee there and be safe from the avenger of blood. The killer must present his case to the elders at the city gate and remain there until he stands trial before the assembly and until the high priest dies. They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hills of Naphtali, Shechem in the hills of Ephraim, and Hebron in the hills of Judah on the west side of the Jordan, as well as Bezer in the wilderness, Ramoth in Gilead, and Golan in Bashan on the east side. These cities applied both to the Israelites and to the foreigners living among them.
